name: Chromaggus
source: [core: vmangos] Melee 3,295 to 4,368 a 2.0 s swing before armor: vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, damage_multiplier 30. Two breaths a lockout, one at 30 s and one at 60 s, each every 60 s. Incinerate 23308 3,675 to 4,725 Fire, Corrosive Acid 23313 875 to 1,125 Nature every 3 s for 15 s (and 3,938 to 5,062 less armor).
notes: Picks Incinerate and Corrosive Acid of the five breaths. Corrosive Acid's armor cut and Frenzy (+150% attack speed every 15 s, removed by Tranquilizing Shot) aren't modelled. Brood Afflictions on the raid are the healing sim's.

healing.notes: A 40-player Blackwing Lair raid's main tank: 4 healers at 500 HPS each in 2 s heals, more healing power than in Molten Core (about 600). Guessed, not from logs: replace with tools/warcraftlogs tank numbers.
